issues.title: Missing Authoritative Source Context (spec/22)
issues.why: The module is a derivative of spec/22, but the actual schema definitions, error registries, and auth logic required to verify diagram correctness are not provided in this context.
issues.fix: Provide spec/22-git-logs-v2/ files in the prompt context to allow 100% confidence verification of diagram parity.

issues.title: External Dependency on xmllint
issues.why: AC-23 Tier 2 requires 'xmllint' for structural XML diffing, which is an external POSIX dependency not guaranteed in all AI coder environments.
issues.fix: Add a fallback python/node script for structural SVG comparison that doesn't rely on system-level libxml2.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'mmdc' Versioning
issues.why: The spec mentions '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli (mmdc)' and 'v11+' but doesn't pin a specific version, which can lead to rendering differences in SVG output.
issues.fix: Pin mmdc to a specific version (e.g., @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.4.0) in the RENDER_TOOL contract.
